races.paceDynamic: Can U Feel It stands as the sole identified front-runner in this small field of 8 hold-up horses, creating a unique tactical scenario where the pace-setter won't face early pressure. This setup allows Can U Feel It to dictate terms uncontested through the early stages, likely setting modest fractions that could prove sustainable over 2m4f. With the entire field bar one adopting waiting tactics, the race will develop into a cavalry charge from the back straight as jockeys scramble for positions on horses that all want to be delivered late. This tactical dynamic strongly favours the front-runner profile, as Can U Feel It can steal crucial lengths while the hold-up brigade gets tangled up behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Can U Feel It maintains a steady gallop without serious challenge until the home turn
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an insurmountable advantage while the pack of hold-up horses struggle to organize their challenge in time. Jack Tudor can dictate the fractions and kick clear when the late runners are still finding their stride.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the field closes significantly on Can U Feel It from 3 out and creates a genuine finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses finally get organized and their superior class ratings tell in a driving finish. Risk It All and Tony Joe have shown they can quicken off the pace when getting the right setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Can U Feel It stops quickly in the final furlong after a solo effort
scenarios.body: The front-runner pays for doing all the donkey work alone and gets swamped by the entire field in the closing stages. This opens the door for any of the hold-up horses with a finishing kick to capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the field gets bunched and blocked behind a steady pace with multiple horses needing room
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as jockeys hunt for gaps and several hold-up horses find themselves with nowhere to go. The winner emerges from whoever gets the clearest passage rather than pure ability.

watchPoints.text: Can U Feel It's jumping - any mistakes will be costly when he's the only one setting the pace and has nowhere to hide
Traffic problems in the straight as 7 hold-up horses converge on limited space with apprentice jockeys Macey and Thompson needing clear runs
Risk It All's ability to finally get his head in front after 9 consecutive defeats over hurdles despite consistent placed efforts
Tony Joe's fitness after 69-day break combined with his trainer's moderate 5/14 recent record suggesting possible readiness issues
Path Of Stars getting the significant weight advantage at bottom weight which could be crucial if the pace sets up right for hold-up horses

runners_data.name: Best Women

runners_data.comment: Suffered mid-race mishap last month and is now 0-9 over fences; has become disappointing
runners_data.spotlight: Seemed to be enjoying hersef in the lead before mid-race mishap at Hereford (3m1f, good; first-time blinkers) last month but she's now 0-9 over fences and has basically become disappointing.

runners_data.name: Gotthereintheend
runners_data.note: Natural front runner gets tactical advantage but poor trainer form at 0/7 in last 14 days raises questions despite suitable race shape.

runners_data.name: Annie Nail
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs racing room but recent good form including two seconds, plus 9-year-old experience and featherweight 142lbs could offset tactical disadvantage.

races.paceDynamic: Gotthereintheend will control the early pace as the sole confirmed front runner in this five-runner field, likely setting a steady tempo without pressure from the prominent runners She Is For Me Boys and Moonlit Potter who will track behind. The hold-up pair Best Women and Annie Nail will settle at the back, relying on late runs up the Fakenham hill. With no pace pressure on Gotthereintheend and a small field creating limited racing room for late closers, this race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Gotthereintheend jumps cleanly and maintains a steady tempo without serious challenge.
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home, while the hold-up horses struggle for racing room in a slowly-run race. This scenario perfectly suits natural front runners who can dictate terms without pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If She Is For Me Boys or Moonlit Potter press Gotthereintheend from the second flight onwards.
scenarios.body: The increased pace sets up for a tactical battle between the forward runners, with Gavin Sheehan's race craft on She Is For Me Boys proving decisive. The hold-up horses still face the same racing room issues in a small field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Late Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the hill provides maximum assistance to strong finishers.
scenarios.body: Annie Nail and Best Women find clear runs and benefit from the stamina test, with Annie Nail's recent good form and light weight proving crucial. The front runners tie up on the climb after dictating a pedestrian tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Decide
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make significant blunders at the packed Fakenham obstacles.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test rather than a pace contest, with whichever horse maintains fluency gaining a decisive advantage. Moonlit Potter's jumping concerns or Gotthereintheend's front-running risks could prove costly.

watchPoints.text: Watch Moonlit Potter's jumping early - any hesitancy will confirm her confidence issues after the Hereford fall.
Watch if She Is For Me Boys or Moonlit Potter press Gotthereintheend early - this could change the entire complexion from a tactical to genuine pace contest.
Watch for traffic problems turning for home - Best Women and Annie Nail need clear runs in this small field to implement their hold-up tactics.
Watch Gotthereintheend's jumping rhythm - any mistakes while leading could hand the advantage to the tracking prominent runners.
Watch the early pace judgment - if genuinely slow, the hill finish could still assist the hold-up pair despite tactical disadvantage.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Kara will lead from the flag with Kernie d'Airy, Mighty Fleur and Johnny's Belle likely to settle prominently behind her. With only one confirmed front runner, Lady Kara can dictate terms without pressure, allowing her to set a sustainable gallop that should see her still traveling well turning for home. The lack of early pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning and timing matter more than raw speed. This setup clearly favors prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in a race run to suit those on or close to the lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Kara gets an easy lead and maintains her jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear from the last, making full use of her consistent hurdles form. The hold-up horses will find themselves with too much to do against a pace-setter who hasn't been softened up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mighty Fleur or Kernie d'Airy can sit handy and pounce late
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can stalk Lady Kara's moderate gallop before producing superior finishing kicks when it matters. Their class edge tells in the final furlong as they sweep past a tiring leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get the perfect setup to unleash late runs, with Blue's Secret Gem or Merely A Detail timing their challenges to perfection. The early leaders pay for going too slowly and get swamped close home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Lady Kara early and force genuine pace
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes too strong, allowing the patient hold-up horses to pick up the pieces as the prominent runners tie up. Ladies Day or Blue's Secret Gem capitalize on the tactical error of those who went too hard too soon.

watchPoints.text: Lady Kara jumps freely early and builds an unassailable lead, as Luke Scott's inexperience could see him let her bowl along too fast or too slow
Mighty Fleur settles kindly in behind after headgear addition, as previous keen-going tendencies could see her race too freely if not relaxing
The pace through the first mile, as only Lady Kara wants to lead which could create a falsely-run race favoring those with tactical speed
Kernie d'Airy's jumping under pressure, having made errors when trying to close gaps in recent starts
How many runners commit to tracking Lady Kara closely, as this will determine whether the hold-up horses get into contention

runners_data.comment: Eight-time chase winner; well suited by good ground; ran well over hurdles last month
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-time chase winner who often makes the running and is very well suited by good or faster ground; went close off his lower hurdle mark last month; on career-high mark from just out of the weights here and usually runs over slightly shorter trips but still features prominently in calculations.

races.paceDynamic: Time To Bite will take them along from the front as the only confirmed leader in this 7-runner field. Numitor and Hold Your Fort are likely to track him prominently, but neither has shown aggressive early tactics that would pressure the pacesetter. The hold-up horses (Hang In There, Kitty's Light, Lord Baddesley, Mars Harper) will be content to settle behind what should be a comfortable gallop over this staying trip. This sets up perfectly for the prominent runners who can track Time To Bite's measured pace and have first run on the closers, making front-running and prominent tactics the profiles to follow.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Time To Bite Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Time To Bite gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: His eight chase wins prove he's most dangerous when allowed to control the tempo, and the lack of pace pressure allows him to kick clear. The prominent trackers get first run but can't match his tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Numitor or Hold Your Fort improve past Time To Bite turning for home
scenarios.body: They get the perfect trip tracking the leader's honest pace before unleashing their superior ratings. Time To Bite's recent hurdles form suggests he may lack the sharpness to respond to their challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and sets up a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Hang In There's class advantage (OR 149) tells as Emma Lavelle's charge produces his trademark late surge. The front-runners pay for going too slowly early and get swamped in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy affair with fallers or interference
scenarios.body: Kitty's Light benefits from the chaos after his long absence, or Mars Harper finds improvement with the 7lb apprentice claim. The established order gets disrupted by circumstances beyond pure ability.

watchPoints.text: Time To Bite's early fractions will determine the entire race outcome - too slow favours closers, too fast helps nothing
Numitor's jumping under pressure if challenging Time To Bite, as errors have cost him in recent prominent efforts
Hold Your Fort's position turning for home, as Freddie Gingell must decide when to improve past the leaders
Hang In There requires genuine pace up front to be effective, but this small field may not provide it
Lord Baddesley's response to first-time cheekpieces, which could sharpen his usual hold-up tactics

races.paceDynamic: Wicked Thoughts and Enjoy d'Allen will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set an honest gallop over this extended trip. Stolen Silver, Stans The Man and Tommie Beau should track prominently behind the leaders, while the hold-up brigade including Northern Poet, Planned Paradise, Unanswered Prayers, Always Busy and Esperti will be held back for late challenges. With only two natural leaders in a 10-runner field, the pace is likely to be solid but not suicidal, creating a searching test of stamina that should favour the prominent racers and strong travellers who can position close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Stolen Silver, Stans The Man or Tommie Beau can track the leaders without over-racing
scenarios.body: The honest pace will stretch the field but the prominent runners avoid the traffic problems that could hinder the hold-up horses. Their tactical positioning allows them to strike at the optimal moment when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early or the prominent runners get involved in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The extended distance plays into the hands of those conserving energy, with Northern Poet and Planned Paradise able to unleash devastating late charges. Their superior class ratings can be maximized with tactical rides.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Wicked Thoughts can dictate terms without serious early pressure from Enjoy d'Allen
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls-trained gelding has winning form at this trip and can control the race from the front. His recent Fakenham success demonstrates his effectiveness when allowed to dominate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and come back to the field dramatically
scenarios.body: A messy pace scenario where the rhythm is lost creates opportunities for horses with tactical speed. Those who can quicken from mid-division when the race falls apart gain the advantage.

watchPoints.text: Wicked Thoughts and Enjoy d'Allen must avoid going too fast early as both confirmed leaders could neutralize each other
Planned Paradise and Northern Poet need the pace to develop properly or their hold-up tactics become ineffective
Stans The Man represents unknown quantity with new trainer Ella Pickard having no runners in recent weeks
Always Busy and Esperti both carry light weights which could prove decisive if the race becomes a stamina test
Stolen Silver faces weight concerns at 170lbs but Miss Nicholls' 5lb claim provides some tactical compensation

races.paceDynamic: Nardaran will likely lead from the front with Royal Way, Dream Diamond, Breezethroughlife, Afadil and Grand Conqueror all capable of racing prominently behind. This creates a genuine pace scenario with multiple prominent runners ensuring a solid gallop throughout. The hold-up horses Rialannah, Chillhi, Kentucky River, Tyson, Secret Vino and Morning Mayhem will have plenty to aim at from the rear. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can sit just off the pace and have first run on the large field of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple prominent runners (Royal Way, Dream Diamond, Breezethroughlife, Afadil, Grand Conqueror) track Nardaran at a solid pace
scenarios.body: The pace will be strong enough to blunt Nardaran's kick while setting up perfectly for those tracking just behind. The hold-up horses will face a wall of horses when they make their move with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If Nardaran goes too fast early or the prominent runners go with him creating a collapse
scenarios.body: The pace will become unsustainable allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Rialannah and Morning Mayhem are best positioned to capitalize with their recent good form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Nardaran Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Nardaran gets an uncontested lead with the prominent runners sitting too quiet early
scenarios.body: Paul Nicholls' runner will dictate terms and prove hard to peg back despite the 168lbs burden. His front-running style will be perfectly suited to controlling this large field from the front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly strong and the prominent runners and hold-up horses neutralize each other
scenarios.body: A horse like Tyson or Kentucky River could benefit from the carnage ahead with their patient styles. The muddling pace would suit those who can stay on strongly when others have shot their bolt.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Nardaran gets an uncontested lead early as Paul Nicholls' front-runner could prove very hard to peg back
Watch Royal Way and Grand Conqueror in the prominent positions as both are in excellent recent form and ideally positioned
Watch how the large group of hold-up horses position themselves as traffic problems could be decisive in a 12-runner field
Watch Dream Diamond's fitness on return from 47-day break as James Owen runners often need their comeback runs
Watch the early pace development as multiple prominent runners could create the perfect scenario for this tactical battle

races.paceDynamic: Eliza Dolittle will take this race forward from the start, with only one other prominent runner in Crackerjack Queen to provide early company. The pace will be measured and sustainable through the first half of the race, allowing the large hold-up contingent (Dartmouth Rose, Masonbrook Meadow, Yanka Blue, Harley's Pride) to settle comfortably in behind. With minimal early pressure on the leader and a strong headwind likely to develop, this sets up perfectly for horses who can produce a sustained finish from off the pace rather than those who need to dominate from the front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Eliza Dolittle sets uncontested fractions and the pace becomes pedestrian through halfway
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash devastating finishing kicks in the final half-mile. Dartmouth Rose and Masonbrook Meadow benefit most from their patient styles and superior recent form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits
scenarios.trigger: If Crackerjack Queen or Yanka Blue apply more pressure to Eliza Dolittle earlier than expected
scenarios.body: A more genuine gallop plays to horses with proven stamina reserves who can grind out the finish. Dartmouth Rose's recent 24f wins and Harley's Pride's 3m success become crucial advantages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Running Pays
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses fail to organize an effective challenge and leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: Eliza Dolittle capitalizes on soft fractions to maintain her advantage, with her prominent running style proving ideal when others are caught flat-footed. Her recent consistency at this trip keeps her in contention throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Eliza Dolittle compounds early and the race becomes a sprint from the final hurdle
scenarios.body: The tactical speed of mid-division runners becomes paramount as stamina becomes less relevant. Crackerjack Queen's prominent style and Yanka Blue's tactical pace both prove decisive in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Eliza Dolittle must be monitored early - if she compounds or runs freely, the entire pace scenario collapses
Crackerjack Queen's fitness after 134-day absence could see her fail to sustain early prominence when pressure mounts
Dartmouth Rose's jumping under pressure will be crucial if she needs to mount a challenge from the back of the field
Masonbrook Meadow's inexperienced rider Macey must time his challenge perfectly to maximize the 5lb weight advantage
Yanka Blue's position turning for home will indicate whether Sheehan believes the pace has been sufficient for her finishing kick
